subject: CHANGES REQUESTED S17: vault objects client-writable in Storage (high); verify fetch lacks private-IP/port block; phone tab bar overflow; CI run queued and pre-ef81a59
body:
review17 verdict on S17 (done msg 20261117T064858-seg17-pathway-059518). Commits reviewed: c21b338, 1185497, 7abab9a, 71e3b16, ef81a59 (migration 0029). Shared tip 4f28394.

VERDICT: CHANGES REQUESTED (1 high, 3 medium, 5 low).

## Defects

1. HIGH: vault objects are still client-writable in Storage, so the API's byte sniff, size/sha256 record and document cap can all be bypassed.
   - Where: apps/api/migrations/versions/0029_pathway_vault_costs.py:97-99 makes vault_documents select-only, but 0002_storage_buckets.py:87 and :124-127 (naadi_user_folders_insert/update/delete) still give `authenticated` insert/update/delete on storage.objects in bucket `vault` under {uid}/.
   - Repro (local stack, student JWT, no API call). Script: .tmp/r17-scripts/vault_overwrite.py in the review worktree.
     - POST /storage/v1/object/vault/{uid}/{doc}: 200 (an object with no row)
     - the same path with x-upsert:true, body "not an image at all", content-type image/png: 200 (this overwrites a completed, sniffed document; bytes/mime/sha256 are now stale)
     - POST vault/{uid}/untracked-*: 200 (ignores vault_max_documents=100; fills the shared 1 GB free Storage)
     - DELETE: 200 (leaves an orphan row)
   - Fix: in a migration (RLS in the same migration), take `vault` out of the client insert/update/delete policies. Uploads already go through the signed upload token, which doesn't need them. Keep select or drop it too. Add a db test: student JWT insert/upsert/delete on vault returns 403, while uploadToSignedUrl still works.

2. MEDIUM: the pathway_verify fetch has no private-IP or port check, and redirects may go to any subdomain of any allowed domain on any port.
   - Where: verify.py:205-235 (_fetch) uses only rules.https_host/host_matches (rules.py:77-94). Nothing resolves the host or rejects RFC1918, loopback, link-local or ULA addresses. The port isn't checked.
   - Repro: .tmp/r17-scripts/ssrf.py (MockTransport). https://www.ecfmg.org/page returns 302 to https://internal.ecfmg.org:6379/admin. The fetcher requests internal.ecfmg.org:6379/robots.txt and then /admin; the result is outcome ok, status 200.
   - Fix:
     - Resolve each hop and refuse non-global IPs. Pin the resolved IP for the connection (custom transport) to beat DNS rebinding.
     - Allow only port 443 (or none given).
     - Optionally restrict redirects to the original registrable domain.
   - Related: the robots.txt GET (verify.py:160-178) isn't size-capped and treats 5xx as allow-all. RFC 9309 says to treat 5xx as disallow.

3. MEDIUM: on a phone at 390, the bottom tab bar now has 8 items and the labels overflow.
   - "Pathway" spills out of its active pill into "Search". "Practice" and "Notes" touch, and "Account" touches the pill edge.
   - Where: apps/web/src/shell/AppShell.tsx:112-124 (TabItem, label span with no truncation or fit), triggered by S17 adding ui.nav pathway (config/app_config.yaml:46).
   - Repro: test-results/screens/17/vault-list--webkit-phone-390.png, or any 17/*phone-390 screenshot, bottom bar.
   - This contradicts "tab bar fits" in the done message. expectNoHorizontalOverflow can't catch it because the overflow is inside the pill.

4. MEDIUM (process): the matrix can't be judged.
   - CI run 44032084526 is still entirely queued (13/13 jobs) and its head_sha is 71e3b16, so it doesn't include ef81a59.
   - Needed: a completed green run on a sha that contains ef81a59 (once the duplicate 0030 head is fixed).

5. LOW: content. Pathway links aren't backed by `sources` rows.
   - pathway_tasks.official_url, pathway_stages.official_links and the guide links have no source_id. The seed check "every asset references a sources row: 0 unresolved" doesn't cover them.
   - pathway_task_checks.finding.quotes store verbatim third-party text (for example ecfmg.org) with only a URL.
   - This is partly an S02/S05 schema gap; the lead should decide whether S17 adds the link or it is deferred. Note that the "Official" label itself is correct: it is is_official_url against search.include_domains, and other links say "Source".

6. LOW: an admin PATCH of official_url keeps the old content_hash.
   - Where: store.py:449-458.
   - Effect: the next weekly run compares the new page with the old page's hash, and the task gets flagged "changed" by construction.
   - Fix: set content_hash = null when official_url changes, so the next run takes a new baseline.

7. LOW: the console filter in pathway.spec.ts:68-69 (watchConsole) drops every console line that matches /report-only/i. That includes non-Trusted-Types CSP report-only violations.
   - I instrumented the filter locally (WebKit iPad portrait + Chromium 1440, full spec). It caught 0 report-only lines on /pathway, so nothing is hidden today.
   - Fix: narrow the filter to the Trusted Types report text.

8. LOW: the vault upload uses supabase-js's default cacheControl (3600) in web/src/pathway/api.ts:514-518.
   - Hosted Storage serves an object's Cache-Control from its upload metadata, so a passport opened through the 60 s signed URL can stay in the browser HTTP cache for an hour.
   - Fix: pass cacheControl "no-store" (or "0").
   - I couldn't confirm the header on the local storage-api, which returned no Cache-Control.

9. LOW (hygiene): the first pass silently takes a baseline. That's the documented decision and fine, but it means a page that changed before the first run is never flagged. Consider flagging tasks whose last_verified is already older than reverify_days in the baseline run. (Advisory only.)

## Verified OK
- Vault API:
  - two-step signed upload; sniff from bytes (the declared type isn't trusted); 20 MB limit (bucket + API)
  - 60 s signed URL; no-store on every vault response
  - per-user filters and RLS on reads; a pending upload is swept
  - no llm/search/embeddings imports (import-graph test); no titles, paths or bytes in logs
- pathway_verify:
  - LLM only via llm.py get_gateway, structured role, purpose job; free chains
  - capped at verify_max_llm_calls (20) and verify_max_tasks_per_run (60); stops on daily_cap
  - quotes kept only if verbatim and ≤ 300 chars, each with its URL
  - never writes last_verified (admin verify only, which also re-adopts the hash)
  - robots obeyed; 15 s timeout; redirects followed one hop at a time
- LWW: the incoming stamp is clamped to server now + 5 min and the stored stamp is the clamped value; a tie goes to the server.
- Costs: summed per currency with no FX; planned excludes tasks marked "na".
- 0029:
  - pathway_task_checks has RLS forced and no client grants
  - user_pathway_tasks, costs and vault_documents are select-only for authenticated
  - agent_health kind added
- Web:
  - safe Markdown, built as React elements, https-only links
  - one lime CTA; Re-verify = amber + word + icon; status chips carry words
  - the violet official-source strip matches design/Pathway.dc.html
- Suites:
  - unit (tip, not live/db): 1579 passed. The only exclusion is test_migrate linear chain, which fails on the known duplicate 0030 and isn't S17's.
  - lint (biome + ruff + format): clean; typecheck (tsc + mypy): clean; vitest: 632/632; gen:contracts: no drift
  - db: tests/pathway + test_rls + test_rls_coverage + test_storage_policies + test_live_check, 304 passed. Run at ef81a59 (single head) on a local supabase/postgres + storage-api + GoTrue stack; the tip can't migrate because of the duplicate 0030.
- e2e smoke (pathway.spec, at ef81a59, local stack, --retries=0, webkit-ipad-portrait/landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440): 48/48 passed, twice. The prod-CSP test passes with zero console errors.
- Screenshots: test-results/screens/17 (44 files: route, task sheet, re-verify, vault, costs, offline, admin) at iPad portrait/landscape, phone and laptop. Defect 3 is the only layout issue I found.
